mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sekai_Draw_lots_record (user_id, character_id, fortune_id, mood, wish_topic, fortune_score, message) VALUES (#{userId}, #{characterId}, #{fortuneId}, COALESCE(#{mood}, '平静'), #{wishTopic}, #{luckScore}, #{message})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sekai_Draw_lots_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sekai_Draw_lots_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(draw_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT MAX(fortune_score) FROM sekai_Draw_lots_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT ROUND(AVG(fortune_score)) FROM sekai_Draw_lots_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT DATE(draw_time) AS draw_day FROM sekai_Draw_lots_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY DATE(draw_time) HAVING draw_day >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) recent_days

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.character_id, r.fortune_id, r.fortune_score AS luck_score, r.mood, r.wish_topic, r.message, r.draw_time, c.id AS c_id, c.english_name, NULL AS japanese_name, c.anime_title, c.role_type AS archetype, c.energy AS element, c.image_url, c.tags AS quote, c.popularity_score AS popularity, f.id AS f_id, f.summary AS title, f.level_name, f.advice, f.lucky_color, f.lucky_item FROM sekai_Draw_lots_record r JOIN sekai_Draw_lots_character c ON r.character_id = c.id JOIN sekai_Draw_lots_fortune f ON r.fortune_id = f.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.draw_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.character_id, r.fortune_id, r.fortune_score AS luck_score, r.mood, r.wish_topic, r.message, r.draw_time, c.id AS c_id, c.english_name, NULL AS japanese_name, c.anime_title, c.role_type AS archetype, c.energy AS element, c.image_url, c.tags AS quote, c.popularity_score AS popularity, f.id AS f_id, f.summary AS title, f.level_name, f.advice, f.lucky_color, f.lucky_item FROM sekai_Draw_lots_record r JOIN sekai_Draw_lots_character c ON r.character_id = c.id JOIN sekai_Draw_lots_fortune f ON r.fortune_id = f.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.character_id, r.fortune_id, r.fortune_score AS luck_score, r.mood, r.wish_topic, r.message, r.draw_time, c.id AS c_id, c.english_name, NULL AS japanese_name, c.anime_title, c.role_type AS archetype, c.energy AS element, c.image_url, c.tags AS quote, c.popularity_score AS popularity, f.id AS f_id, f.summary AS title, f.level_name, f.advice, f.lucky_color, f.lucky_item FROM sekai_Draw_lots_record r JOIN sekai_Draw_lots_character c ON r.character_id = c.id JOIN sekai_Draw_lots_fortune f ON r.fortune_id = f.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.wish_topic = '每日固定签' AND DATE(r.draw_time) = CURDATE() ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1
